description:
Collect inventory data and metrics of your hosts and sends it to the New Relic platform.


What's Changed
Security notices
- chore(deps): bump golang.org/x/net to v0.60.0, fixing CVE-2026-78669 (HIGH) - net/http2 denial of service via excessive SETTINGS frames in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2364
Bug fixes
- fix: Prevent the agent from crashing if clean temp folder fails and fall back to manual delete on ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION / STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2354
- fix: hide safe dir check behind a config in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2357
- Fix: Update core integrations in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2359
- revert #2306 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2362
Other changes
- chore(deps): bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.7.35 to 1.7.36 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2353
- Optimize the if else condition in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2360
- chore(deps): bump github.com/moby/sys/user from 0.3.0 to 0.4.1 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2363
- chore: bump embedded OHI versions (nri-docker, nri-flex, nri-winservices, nri-prometheus) in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2365
Full Changelog: https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/compare/1.80.5...1.80.6
